title: Visualisations
headline: The flying-fish blueprint is drawn in 3D at /blueprint3d/: 536 distinct ontology terms (13 organ systems, 67 organs, 198 tissues, 257 cell types) and 674 part_of edges, each node showing its term, the SPARQL query that produced it, and the kernel-checked structural certificate that covers it beside the biological Lean statement it does not have (0 of 536 terms appear in any Lean statement); the canvas says the layout is a projection of the ontology hierarchy, not anatomy. The genes view is built but gated: genotype/map.json exists (38 MB, unvetted) and nothing is drawn until the genotype thread writes genotype/map.vetted.json or sets vetted:true; a local preview showed 79 nodes with direct proxy-fish records (zebrafish, medaka), labelled as such. /graph/ hides its 213 datasets by default and its Ideas view now reads 12 ideas: 4 researched, 5 reach-synthesis (not yet checked against prior art), 3 serendipitous.

run node dashboard/build-graph.mjs before each deploy: it writes dashboard/public/graph.json and dashboard/public/blueprint3d/data.json; never deploy a build made with VIZ_UNGATED_TEST=1
